title: Bitcoin and ether slide as futures liquidations hit $483 million
excerpt: October 15’s Asian session brought losses across major tokens, with ether accounting for the larger share of reported BTC and ETH liquidations.

title: Strive discloses 2,822 BTC purchase alongside $369.2 million warrant proceeds
excerpt: An SEC filing details Bitcoin purchases on October 12–13 and new financing proceeds. The purchase and financing totals are separate figures.

title: Standard Chartered announces Bitcoin and ether trading for eligible UAE clients
excerpt: The bank’s October 14 announcement describes account-based crypto trading with integrated custody for eligible affluent clients.

title: Kraken parent Payward signs Saldo Bank acquisition agreement
excerpt: The proposed European banking deal is expected to close in 2027, subject to approvals and closing conditions.

title: Babylon proposes native Bitcoin collateral for Aave V4
excerpt: An October 14 governance proposal outlines Bitcoin vault collateral and stablecoin borrowing. It remains a proposal rather than a confirmed launch.
